mapper.insert: insert into raffle_activity_account(user_id, activity_id, total_count, total_count_surplus, day_count, day_count_surplus, month_count, month_count_surplus) values (#{userId}, #{activityId}, #{totalCount}, #{totalCountSurplus}, #{dayCount}, #{dayCountSurplus}, #{monthCount}, #{monthCountSurplus})
mapper.update: update raffle_activity_account set total_count_surplus=total_count_surplus - 1, month_count_surplus=month_count_surplus - 1, day_count_surplus=day_count_surplus - 1 where user_id = #{userId} and activity_id = #{activityId} and total_count_surplus > 0 and month_count_surplus > 0 and day_count_surplus > 0
mapper.select: select user_id, activity_id, total_count, total_count_surplus, day_count, day_count_surplus, month_count, month_count_surplus from raffle_activity_account where user_id = #{userId} and activity_id = #{activityId}
